verdict.summary: Round 3 fixes the prior major finding: actions/checkout is now explicitly pinned to github.event.pull_request.head.sha with full history, and the merge step fails closed unless git rev-parse HEAD exactly equals HEAD_SHA before merging the resolved origin/base branch. The accompanying TestPreMergeC1Job assertion now pins both the explicit checkout ref and the runtime HEAD verification, so the previous vacuous coverage (HEAD_SHA merely appearing in reporting) is gone. The remaining workflow behavior is consistently and candidly scoped: conflicts produce no C1 verdict, the tested base SHA is published, and merge_group remains the authoritative non-stale check. No hostile reviewer-directed instruction was detected in the diff.
